rules.statement: The write domain CLK-WR is clocked by i_clk_wr on its rising edge, with no clock gating inside the IP.
The read domain CLK-RD is clocked by i_clk_rd on its rising edge, with no clock gating inside the IP.

rules.condition: Write Gray pointer crossing CLK-WR to CLK-RD (CDC-001)
rules.statement: The write Gray pointer is registered in CLK-WR, then passes through m_vlsit_afifo_sync (2/3/4 stages) in the read domain, reset by i_rst_n_rd to PARA_AFIFO_SYNC_RST_VAL.

rules.condition: Read Gray pointer crossing CLK-RD to CLK-WR (CDC-002)
rules.statement: The read Gray pointer is registered in CLK-RD, then passes through m_vlsit_afifo_sync in the write domain, reset by i_rst_n_wr.

rules.condition: Stored data crossing CLK-WR to CLK-RD (CDC-003)
rules.statement: Stored data is read by the read domain without a synchronizer and must be stable by the pointer protocol when read.
i_full_thr and i_empty_thr are static, written once before the FIFO is used and not changed while in use, and are not synchronized.

rules.condition: Software reset request crossing CLK-WR to CLK-RD (CDC-005)
rules.statement: req_wr is registered in CLK-WR, then passes through a 1-bit m_vlsit_afifo_sync (2/3/4 stages) in the read domain, reset to 0 by i_rst_n_rd.

rules.condition: Software reset acknowledge crossing CLK-RD to CLK-WR (CDC-006)
rules.statement: ack_rd is registered in CLK-RD, then passes through a 1-bit m_vlsit_afifo_sync in the write domain, reset to 0 by i_rst_n_wr.

rules.condition: Between the launch Gray register and the first synchronizer stage, and between stages
rules.statement: No combinational logic is allowed between the launch Gray register and the first synchronizer stage, nor between synchronizer stages.
Logic such as Gray-to-binary conversion and compare may follow the last synchronizer stage.
The bundled-data assumption of CDC-003 shall be waived with the documented rationale in the CDC tool.
The software reset is a synchronous reset of pointers and flags performed by each domain's FSM and adds no asynchronous reset or reset-domain crossing.
The two hardware resets are independent inputs and need not be asserted together.

rules.condition: Only one domain is reset after the FIFO was used
rules.statement: The IP neither detects nor repairs the inconsistent pointer state that results from resetting only one domain.
i_rst_n_wr is active-low, asserts asynchronously, and resets all write-domain state, the read-pointer synchronizer and flags: pointers 0, full 0, overflow 0.
i_rst_n_rd is active-low, asserts asynchronously, and resets all read-domain state, the write-pointer synchronizer and flags: pointers 0, empty 1, underflow 0.
i_rst_n_sw is an active-low synchronous software reset acting through both FSMs, resetting pointers to 0, o_empty to 1, o_full to 0, without clearing storage.
Software reset deassertion follows the Section 10.7 handshake, read side first.
Control and validity state (pointers, flags) are reset.
FIFO storage is resetless; its content is not consumed until the write pointer proves it was written, and o_rd_data while empty is undefined until written.

rules.condition: Hardware reset asserted, including during a software reset
rules.statement: i_rst_n_wr and i_rst_n_rd act asynchronously on the FSMs and pointers of their domain at any time, also during a software reset.

rules.condition: Only one domain gets a hardware reset during a software reset
rules.statement: The IP does not repair the case where the handshake waits forever for the other domain.
